mercado_libre_item_changed_trigger.description: Runs when one of your listings changes: its price, stock, status or anything else. Looks at the 20 most recently changed each time.

output.item: The whole listing, as Mercado Libre returns it.
output.item_id: The listing's id, such as MLA1136716168.

output.item: The whole listing, as Mercado Libre returns it.
output.item_id: The listing's id, such as MLA1136716168.
output.status: Its status, such as active or paused.
output.title: Its title.

mercado_libre_new_message_trigger.description: Runs when a buyer sends you a message about a sale you haven't read yet. 'Get order messages' with its order reads them.

output.order_id: The order the conversation is about, for 'Get order messages'.
output.pack_id: The cart (pack) the conversation belongs to.
output.unread_count: How many of its messages you haven't read.

mercado_libre_new_order_trigger.description: Runs for each new sale, with its items, amount, buyer and shipment. Orders already there when the workflow is turned on don't start it.

output.item_titles: The titles of the listings bought.
output.order: The whole order, as Mercado Libre returns it.
output.pack_id: The cart (pack) it belongs to, if several were bought together.
output.shipment_id: The shipment's id, for 'Get shipment'; empty without one.
output.status: Its status: confirmed, payment_required, payment_in_process, partially_paid, paid, cancelled, invalid.
output.total_amount: What the buyer pays for the items.

parameters.description: Only orders in this status, such as paid. One of: confirmed, payment_required, payment_in_process, partially_paid, paid, cancelled, invalid. Leave blank for every new order.
parameters.name: status

parameters.name: item_id
